name: batch12
rows: bolt-action sniper rifle: a dark grey-brown laminated wooden thumbhole stock with a cheek rest and an adjustable butt plate, a long thin barrel with a big muzzle brake, a bolt handle, a short box magazine and a folding bipod under the front. No scope.

bullpup assault rifle in olive green: olive plastic stock and handguard with slots, a black receiver with a carrying handle on top, a front sight post, a pistol grip in front of a long magazine that sits behind the grip, and a flash hider on a thin barrel.
black polymer pistol: a long slide with serrations at the front and the back, a rail under the barrel, a tall straight grip with a checkered texture, a trigger guard and a small rear sight. No text.

black general-purpose machine gun: a thumbhole stock, a pistol grip, a long thin barrel with a carrying handle over it, a front sight at the muzzle, a bipod folded out under the front and a green ammunition box hanging under the receiver. No watermark.

modern dark-sand coloured general-purpose machine gun: a thumbhole stock, a pistol grip, a rail along the top of the receiver, a long thin barrel with a carrying handle over it, a bipod folded out under the front and an olive ammunition box hanging under the receiver. No watermark.
